reviews.text: We hired a local pool service company in Mansfield for our backyard pool project, and we couldn't be happier with the results. They offered us a great price, and Jay was fantastic to work with during the design stage. He took the time to explain every detail in simple terms, which we really appreciated as first-time pool owners. During construction, Louis made sure everything stayed on schedule and managed the whole process smoothly. Anytime we had questions or needed to discuss anything, Louis was always available and helped us quickly resolve any concerns. Our pool was finished just in time for the hot Mansfield summer, and we've been enjoying every minute of it! As newcomers to pool ownership, we didn’t know what to expect, but the team made the whole process easy and stress-free. The end result is absolutely beautiful, and our family loves spending time in the pool. The company showed real professionalism and dedication, making sure we understood each step and were comfortable throughout the project. We highly recommend their pool service to anyone in Mansfield looking to transform their backyard into a relaxing oasis.
reviews.author: Kerri Lyons

reviews.text: I rarely leave reviews, but I felt I had to after such a fantastic experience. Mansfield Local Pool Maintenance provided outstanding pool service from beginning to end. Louis helped design a beautiful, simple, and affordable pool setup that fits perfectly with our outdoor space. There were some tricky areas in our yard, but Louis went the extra mile to make everything work smoothly. Jay managed the project and was wonderful to communicate with—always prompt, professional, and clear. Even when I reached out with questions late in the evening, he responded quickly and kept me updated on every step of the process. The team kept the area tidy and their work was top-notch. Overall, this has been the most stress-free home improvement project I’ve ever experienced. I highly recommend this pool service to anyone looking for reliable and friendly help with their pool in Texas, where keeping cool in the heat is so important.
reviews.author: Dwayne Nunez

reviews.text: After looking into several different companies, we chose to have our pool and spa built by a local pool service in Mansfield. We are extremely happy with both the entire process and how our backyard turned out. The team was great at keeping us informed at every step, and everything was done on time just as promised. All the workers, including Jay and Andres, were friendly and made sure to keep the area neat and tidy throughout the project. Everyone was honest and easy to work with. If you are thinking about pool construction or pool service, this is definitely a company you can trust.
reviews.author: Jodi B

reviews.text: We recently had our pool in Mansfield professionally resurfaced, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. Our old waterline tile was falling off and the bullnose edging was chipping and loose from a previous job, so there were actually two layers of old pool material that had to be removed. The crew carefully took the bottom all the way down to the pool shell to make sure the in-floor pool cleaning system would work just right. They also removed any loose coating along the pool walls. All new fittings were installed, except for the pop-up on the cleaning system, which was still under warranty. Evan, who installed the new tile, did an excellent job in every way. The team that handled the pool finish was also fantastic—every curve, inside and out, is now perfectly smooth. They had to apply a lot of new finish material because of how much old stuff was taken off, but they worked well together and really knew what needed to be done. Before, you could see marks and blemishes from the old coating just by looking at the surface, but now everything looks flawless. We chose a brand-new shade for the finish, and so far, we’re the only ones in Mansfield with this unique color. The waterline tile and new bullnose we picked look amazing with the finish. Louis was on site several times throughout the demolition and finishing process to oversee the work and make sure everything was on track. They also sent a pool technician, Jay, out multiple times to test the water and make sure the pool chemicals were always perfect. Jay was very knowledgeable and took the time to explain how we could keep our pool sparkling clean, especially since we use well water and there are extra things to watch for. Everyone from this company was professional and did exactly what was promised at the agreed price. We are really impressed and would highly recommend their pool cleaning and resurfacing services. OUTSTANDING!
reviews.author: Linda N

reviews.text: I am so grateful for the help I received updating my 20-year-old pool. Jay did an amazing job installing a solar loop, a smart controller, and the PVC work was super clean and professional. The whole team is always friendly and helpful whenever I stop by for water tests, pool cleaning tools, parts, or chemicals. It’s always a pleasure getting what I need for my pool from this great local business in Mansfield.
reviews.author: Cristian P

reviews.text: Jay did an excellent job with our pool cleaning and maintenance. Communication was clear from start to finish, and we are really pleased with how everything turned out. He installed new pool deck drains for us, carefully cutting a straight line into the existing concrete. Jay was professional and made sure the area was spotless when he finished. We would definitely recommend these pool cleaning services to friends and neighbors.
reviews.author: Jimmy Mata

reviews.text: after reaching out to a couple other pool service companies and not getting much help, we finally found a team that really delivered. we needed our old pool surface redone since it was definitely showing its age. todd came out right when he said he would, checked out the pool, and showed us some great pebble and tile samples. he also suggested we restain the deck to match the fresh new pool look. they sent us a quote just a couple days later and were super responsive and fair on price. every crew that came by did their part and always left our yard clean and tidy. louis kept us in the loop by calling with updates about when things would start and what to expect. the whole process felt smooth and organized. everyone was friendly and really knew what they were doing. we are so happy with how our pool remodel turned out, and we wouldn’t go anywhere else for pool service in the future. everything looks fantastic and we wish we had done this sooner.
reviews.author: Victoria16 M

reviews.text: after getting several estimates to resurface and retile my pool, i picked this company because louis was quick to answer all my questions and made everything easy by handling the whole process from start to finish. louis brought out samples and gave me clear price estimates based on what i liked. he stayed involved the entire time, kept me updated on the progress, and made sure everything was moving along smoothly. the crew did top-notch work and left my backyard clean when they finished. this company really cares about their customers and takes pride in their pool service. i highly recommend them to anyone in mansfield looking for reliable pool work.
reviews.author: Ariana Reid
